summary: Reconciled the remote popup Capture route, Settings About readiness controls, and Vault browser acceptance scenarios with canonical feature controls and concrete cases. Source inspection only; no product tests, build, browser, or network writes were performed.

changes.reason: Capture page now writes a short-lived per-window launch intent, opens the sidepanel, and routes to Scrape. Failure remains visible and retryable.
changes.engineering_defect_link: EXT-D-0008 in member/admin cells; release-guard classification only, no observed user-facing failure and no behavior pass implied.

changes.reason: Settings About now exposes browser/build identity, saved-login API readiness and remedy, and browser update-check outcomes or managed-update instructions. Applicability is guest/member/admin because the section is not auth gated.

Vault acceptance source now checks stale pending-offer invalidation after active-organization switch and a fresh Vault read after replacement browser/sidepanel binding. These remain execution procedures, not product-test results.

preserved_history: No existing result, run link, defect link, or feature identity was removed or overwritten. All new/changed cases remain unverified.

diagnostic_assessment.normal_vitest_discovery: excluded: configured include roots are tests/unit/**/*.test.ts(x) and src/**/*.test.ts(x); docs/stabilization/diagnostics is outside them.
diagnostic_assessment.duplication: historical copy duplicates the original two persisted-profile Strict Mode assertions; current canonical active regression is src/hooks/use-auth.strict-mode.test.tsx and contains those profiles plus additional verification/race cases.
diagnostic_assessment.action: Preserved the archived test artifact and replaced stale instructions in the neighboring markdown. Do not delete or run the archived artifact as a release check.

agents.consumer_action: 0.13.14 says no source changes and no consumer action required.

content_ir.consumer_action: 0.19.0's SchemaSourcePort/createKindValidator migration is directed at matrx-frontend. No extension consumer action is required by that entry; extension does not consume this new validator API.

dependency_refresh.status: inspected after dependency refresh; no mandatory extension adoption identified

unresolved: All reconciled product behavior remains runtime-unverified in this lane.
D7 final native acceptance is pending; the current active unit regression exists and the archived diagnostic remains non-discovered.
EXT-D-0008 release-guard finding is linked to signed-in popup Capture cells; source repair/release integration remains owned by the root task.

followups.finding: Capture intents now begin pending and become armed only after panel open succeeds and exactly one sidepanel context is confirmed for the initiating window. The armed request carries that context ID, and only that context can consume it. The existing popup cases now cover pending/armed order, same-window/same-active-tab expectations, exact panel-instance matching, stale reopened contexts, and missing/ambiguous context recovery; no duplicate cases or controls were needed. All remain unverified in the inventory.
followups.tab_binding_limit: Implementation binds the route to a window and panel context; it does not store a tab ID. The case verifies the active tab is unchanged and no tab is created during the action, without claiming the request has a tab-ID binding.

vault_observer_commit.reason: Test harness detaches the old logout observer before destroying its panel and binds a new observer to the final panel; no product behavior or user-facing Vault control changed.

followups.test_result_note: Root reported popup-cleanup-green-002 as passing 17 checks including the guard. This lane did not run or independently verify that result; inventory behavior remains runtime-unverified.
